---
title: "Data Science & Software Engineering"
listing:
  contents: projects.yml
  type: grid
  categories: true
  sort: "order desc"
  fields: [image, title, description, categories, feature]
  grid-columns: 2
  image-height: "280px"
---

This my collection of curated content on **data science** and **software engineering**.

Select a category on the side to filter projects, or click a card to view the deployed application or notebook.

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function applyFeatured() {
    document
      .querySelectorAll('#listing-listing .card-other-values .feature')
      .forEach(function (td) {
        var isFeatured = (td.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'true';
        var gridItem = td.closest('.quarto-grid-item');
        var colWrapper = td.closest('[class*="g-col"]');
        if (gridItem) gridItem.classList.toggle('card-featured', isFeatured);
        if (colWrapper) colWrapper.classList.toggle('g-col-featured', isFeatured);
      });
  }

  function init() {
    applyFeatured();
    var listEl = document.querySelector('#listing-listing .list');
    if (listEl) {
      // List.js reorders/refilters nodes; re-apply so classes survive.
      new MutationObserver(applyFeatured).observe(listEl, { childList: true });
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
```
